query: Explain the new checkout state machine and show it visually. I need to understand how payment, inventory reservation, and order confirmation move between states.
expected_behavior: Chooses a state flow or data-flow visual because the subject is lifecycle and boundary movement, not a generic prose summary
Grounds the visual in actual repo artifacts such as state names, functions, events, files, or integrations from the checkout change
Keeps the visual focused on the single load-bearing model instead of touring every checkout file
Explains how the reader can use the visual to predict what breaks when a state transition or boundary changes
Does not create a decorative or unrelated visual when a compact diagram is enough
